options.text: A reaction where a nucleophile attacks the electrophilic carbonyl carbon to generate a tetrahedral alkoxide intermediate.

options.label: B
options.text: A compound containing a carbon–nitrogen double bond (C=N-R) formed by the acid-catalyzed condensation of an aldehyde or ketone with a primary amine.

options.label: C
options.text: A functional group consisting of a carbon atom doubly bonded to an oxygen atom (C=O), characterized by a strong dipole and electrophilic carbon.

options.label: D
options.text: A functional group featuring two alkoxy groups bonded to the same carbon (R2C(OR')2), formed by the acid-catalyzed reaction of a carbonyl with two equivalents of alcohol.

questions.correct_answer: A functional group consisting of a carbon atom doubly bonded to an oxygen atom (C=O), characterized by a strong dipole and electrophilic carbon.
